expected.baseline: project synthetic Recycle Bin $I file fixture; v2 format header, file_size, deletion FILETIME, and original UTF-16LE path validated against known values

guaranteedFields.name: recovered_file_size
guaranteedFields.description: original file size in bytes from $I header; always present in valid $I files

guaranteedFields.name: deletion_time
guaranteedFields.description: deletion FILETIME from $I header converted to UTC RFC 3339; null when FILETIME is zero, max, or out of reasonable year range (2001-2099)

guaranteedFields.name: original_path
guaranteedFields.description: original file path from $I file (UTF-16LE decoded, null-terminated); null when header_size <= 24 or path is empty after trimming

bestEffortFields.name: header_size
bestEffortFields.description: $I header size field; determines whether path follows the fixed-size header; value varies between v1 and v2 formats

bestEffortFields.name: original_filename
bestEffortFields.description: filename extracted from original_path (last path component); derived field, not directly parsed

bestEffortFields.name: recycled_file_extension
bestEffortFields.description: file extension extracted from original_path; derived field

notGuaranteedFields.name: $R_file_content_match
notGuaranteedFields.description: verification that $R file content matches $I recorded size; requires paired $R file which may not always be present

notGuaranteedFields.name: corrupted_i_file_recovery
notGuaranteedFields.description: recovery of partial path from corrupted/damaged $I files; known limitation documented in parser-support-matrix.md

notGuaranteedFields.name: v1_format_support
notGuaranteedFields.description: Windows XP-style Recycle Bin (INFO2 format); not supported, only v2 $I/$R format

notGuaranteedFields.name: unicode_normalization_form
notGuaranteedFields.description: UTF-16LE path normalization variant; surrogate pairs and normalization forms may vary by Windows version

expected.fieldNamingConvention: camelCase for top-level DTO; snake_case for attrs map keys within artifacts
expected.timezoneNormalizationRule: deletion FILETIME converted to UTC via Windows epoch offset (1601-01-01); serialized as RFC 3339; timestamps outside year range 2001-2099 are excluded as unreasonable

emptyValueStrategy.null: absent deletion_time (FILETIME zero, max, or out of range) or absent original_path (header_size <= 24 or path string empty)
emptyValueStrategy.emptyString: original_path present but empty after UTF-16LE decode and trim (treated as absent)
emptyValueStrategy.zero: valid zero for file_size (should not occur for valid $I files)

expected.sortOrderRule: artifacts sorted by deletion_time descending; timeline events sorted by timestamp ascending
